## Episode Thesis

The episode covers Swedish mutual funds, with journalist Frida Bratt as guest. Her review found that several of the largest Swedish and global equity funds, especially those run by the big banks, have low active risk and low active share while charging fees of 1.2–1.5%. That makes them effectively closet index funds. No individual stocks are recommended. The discussion is about fund fees, transparency around active risk and active share, and US and tech concentration risk in global funds.
